title: Monoculture growth rates predict community assembly under multiple environmental stressors: data, code and model fits
description:
Analysis code, processed data and cached Bayesian model fits for Monoculture growth rates predict community assembly under multiple environmental stressors (Carmichael, Cakin, Warfield, Busi, Read and Yvon-Durocher).

Contents: R scripts and Stan models for the Dirichlet-softmax composition model, the abundance-weighted mean growth to OD600 regression, blocked cross-validation by community identity, leave-one-stress-out, leave-one-taxon-out and singles-to-combinations transfer tests; processed 16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant tables, sequencing metadata, community OD600 data and monoculture growth rates; all cached Stan fits, so that every published table and figure regenerates without refitting; and the Quarto sources of the manuscript and supplementary information.

Raw amplicon reads are deposited at the European Nucleotide Archive (see the Data availability statement). Monoculture growth rates were subset from the performance-curve dataset of Carmichael et al. (2025), archived separately on Zenodo.
